module Answering
  class RetrievalTool
    def initialize(tenant_id:, authorize:)
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @authorize = authorize
    end

    def call(query:, tenant_id: nil)
      raise SecurityError, 'unauthorized retrieval' unless @authorize.call(@tenant_id)
      raise SecurityError, 'tenant override' if tenant_id && tenant_id != @tenant_id

      Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: @tenant_id).select { |row| row.fetch('body').include?(query) }
    end
  end

--- app/services/knowledge/embedding_job.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)
      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
        return :discarded unless current && current.revision == snapshot.revision

        Embedding.upsert({ document_id: current.id, tenant_id: tenant_id, revision: current.revision,
                           version: version, vector: JSON.generate(vector) }, unique_by: %i[document_id version])
      end
      :stored
    end
  end
end
--- app/services/knowledge/publish_delivery.rb
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class PublishDelivery
    def call(delivery_id:, store:)
      delivery = Delivery.find(delivery_id)
      payload = JSON.parse(delivery.payload)
      begin
        store.publish(id: delivery.event_id, type: 'DocumentPublished', data: payload)
      rescue store.duplicate_error
        existing = store.read(delivery.event_id)
        raise 'conflicting event' unless existing == { type: 'DocumentPublished', data: payload }
      end
      delivery.update!(delivered: true)
      :delivered
    end
  end
end

module Knowledge
  class RebuildSearch
    def call(index:, after_backfill: -> {})
      candidate = index.create_candidate
      index.replace(candidate, documents)
      after_backfill.call
      Document.transaction do
        index.replace(candidate, documents)
        raise 'candidate validation failed' unless index.valid?(candidate, documents)

        index.activate(candidate)
      end
      candidate
    end

    private

    def documents
      Document.where(published: true).order(:id).map do |document|
        document.attributes.slice('id', 'tenant_id', 'body', 'revision')
      end
    end
  end

I need to check if the current setup contradicts any design by linking Catalog directly to Document and assess consistency since persistence in internal Knowledge shouldn't lead to a Controller without a Document.

cat > docs/knowledge-boundary-rollback.md <<'EOF'
# Knowledge boundary rollback

The catalog extraction is intentionally a service boundary only. The existing
`documents`, `embeddings`, and `deliveries` tables and their records remain
unchanged, and no persistence conversion is part of this change.

If this boundary needs to be rolled back, revert the delivery adapter and the
catalog service together, then run the characterization and existing tests.
The `/documents` authorization and response contract must remain unchanged.
Because persistence was not migrated, rollback requires no database migration,
backfill, or data restore. Keep `Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id:)` as the
compatibility point if another caller has adopted it; only its delivery wiring
should be reverted in that case.
EOF
cat > test/catalog_test.rb <<'EOF'
# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'test_helper'

class CatalogTest < BenchmarkTest
  def test_lists_only_published_documents_for_tenant_in_id_order
    later = document(tenant: 'a', body: 'later')
    earlier = document(tenant: 'a', body: 'earlier', revision: 3)
    document(tenant: 'a', body: 'draft', published: false)
    document(tenant: 'b', body: 'other tenant')

    assert_equal [earlier.id, later.id], Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: 'a').map { |row| row.fetch('id') }

    assert_equal 'a', Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: 'a').first.fetch('tenant_id')
    assert_equal 'earlier', Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: 'a').first.fetch('body')
    assert_equal 3, Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: 'a').first.fetch('revision')
  end
end
EOF
